title: Galeazzo Visconti to Anne de Montmorency, Campo a Landriano, 30 Aug 1528, BnF fr. 3034 f. 154, no. 68 (DECODE R4223)

documents.shelfmark: BnF, Français 3034, f. 154r-v, no. 68 (DECODE R4223); Gallica btv1b90600370 views 243, 244
documents.route: Campo a Landriano (League army camp, Lombardy) -> Anne de Montmorency, grand maitre

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf. Lasry's key table (05/11/2023) on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm covers this cipher; no plaintext of the letter published.

transcription.source: Gallica native views 243 (30 recto cipher lines) and 244 (9 verso lines), deskewed; line crops; glyph-by-glyph passes in reading_*.md and final.md
transcription.notes: 1344 = tokens of the first rough transcription cipher.txt (_check_profile --measure --drop-first). The glyph-level passes count 1338 cipher glyphs by eye (final.md), code groups counted as in the reading files.

system.summary: Invented-sign substitution for Italian with a few homophones (three E forms, two A forms), a sign for CHE, and a numbered nomenclator written with figures (48, 4θ, 4r) and letter groups (rr, qq, peu).
system.notes: Diagonal word-divider strokes were added under the lines later by a decipherer. Pi and a few one-off signs may be nulls (not proved).

prior_solution.where: Lasry key table (05/11/2023) 'BNF Francais 3045f28 and 3034f154 - Italian' on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm; key only, no plaintext; DECODE Non-decrypted; no edition found

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the catalogue card (item 177). No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE R4223 (Non-decrypted, unknown sender); Tomokiyo GL.htm lists the leaf under Galeazzo Visconti's cipher with Lasry's key table; web search found no edition.
Gallica btv1b90600370: f.154r = view 243, f.154v = view 244 (f.153 = view 242, clear); natives downloaded and deskewed.
Rough token transcription of 39 cipher lines (cipher.txt) with decode.py applying Lasry's key.
Lasry's table applied: Italian reads ('il consiglio de heri fu per tirare queli capitanei').
Recto re-transcribed glyph by glyph by line agents (reading_r01-15.md, reading_r16-30.md); line drift corrected; the diagonal strokes identified as later word dividers.
Key extended from the reading: ne=S, me=L, y=N/B, theta=G, p=M, far=CHE, fu=FU, q=H/F, three E forms.
Recto read: council of war at Landriano, Milan vs Pavia, Francesco's scheme with the Venetian officers, Visconti interrupted.
Second pass (final.md): verso redone glyph by glyph, every open recto spot retried; 1240/1338 glyphs read.
Siblings fr. 3045 f.28 and fr. 3096 f.91r opened: key confirmed ('mal tratamento'); crossed sign = figure 4, so 48/4θ/4r are numbered codes; rr, qq recur as groups; no key for the codes.

Third pass with the visconti1529 sibling rules on every open stretch (tokens.txt, count_tokens.py): fuo = fu, r09 qq and r21 rr (overbarred) are codes, v07 spurious A removed; enhancement (autocontrast, unsharp, threshold, 2x) shows the v03 middle legible with code 4r. 1247/1337 = 93.3%.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's key table on Tomokiyo's GL.htm (2023) is headed with this very leaf ('BNF Francais 3045f28 and 3034f154'); it was applied and extended from the reading, with the siblings fr. 3045 f. 28 and fr. 3096 f. 91 used to confirm it.
outcome.notes: Letter text read in part; the numbered nomenclator codes (4r also in v03, rr in r21, qq in r09), a recurring final sign pair, one-off signs and one blotted spot (v01) open.

gaps.item: nomenclator codes 48 (x2), 4θ, 4r (r25, v03), rr (r21), qq (r09), peu (x2)
gaps.detail: numbered code; no key in Lasry, Tomokiyo or the siblings

gaps.item: final sign pair of so../lo../do.. (r10-12); one-off signs and stretches r07, r09, r12, r16, r21, r27, r30, v07, v08, v09
gaps.detail: occur only here; no sibling occurrence; third-pass readings needed two or more slips

gaps.item: v01 blotted ψ̄ and ſt ligature
gaps.detail: solid ink blot, unchanged after enhancement
